title: TPG’s Asia OneHealthcare Is Said to Confidentially File for $2.5 Billion IPO
summary: TPG Inc.-backed Asia OneHealthcare Sdn. has confidentially filed for an initial public offering in Kuala Lumpur to potentially raise as much as 10 billion ringgit ($2.5 billion), according to people with knowledge of the matter.

title: Diversified Energy Buys Elliott-Backed Birch for $1.8 Billion
summary: Diversified Energy Co. agreed to acquire Elliott Investment Management-backed oil and gas company Birch Resources in a deal valued at about $1.8 billion.

title: Japan’s 30-Year Bond Auction Risks Adding Fuel to Debt Selloff
summary: Japan’s 30-year government bond auction Thursday will test investor appetite as a global selloff pushes long-dated yields to their highest levels in almost two decades.

title: Asian Stocks Advance as Oil Slips, Yen in Focus: Markets Wrap
summary: Asian stocks rose and oil snapped a three-day rally after President Donald Trump played down the prospect of a prolonged conflict with Iran.

title: Yen’s Spike Leaves Traders Guessing About Intervention
summary: A surge in the yen during US trading hours highlighted the nervous tension surrounding the currency in the run up to the Bank of Japan’s meeting later this month.

title: Yen Surge Puts Traders on High Alert for Intervention
summary: A sharp rise in the yen during New York trading has put traders on high alert for any evidence that authorities will return to the market following intervention in July. Bloomberg's Mark Cranfield has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Congo Ebola Outbreak: Health Worker ‘Ghost’ Pay Disputes Hamper Response
summary: Six Ebola checkpoints in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo stopped reporting last month because the people staffing them hadn’t been paid.

title: Natixis Raises Japan Stocks Allocation, Cuts US Equity Exposure
summary: Natixis Investment Managers has raised its allocation to Japanese equities, betting the nation’s economic growth momentum will endure as inflationary pressures push government bond yields higher, its strategists told Bloomberg in a recent interview.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 3
summary: Oil steadied after a three-day rally as President Donald Trump said renewed attacks on Iran would be short-lived, while US officials signaled robust energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Dollar Debasement Is Favoring Singapore’s Currency, Analysts Say
summary: The Singapore dollar is tracking the US currency in an inverse direction more closely than any other in Asia, which analysts say positions it for stronger gains in the region if the “dollar debasement trade” gathers pace.

title: World’s Unusually High Dollar Exposure Risks Fueling Selloff
summary: Sift through the filings of pension funds and insurers around the world and one thing stands out: some of the biggest holders of US assets have little protection against a weaker dollar, leaving the currency at risk of steeper declines if sentiment suddenly turns.

title: Gold Holds Gain as Trump’s War Comments Ease Inflation Jitters
summary: Gold held a gain as US President Donald Trump appeared to rule out prolonged military action in the Middle East, easing inflationary concerns driven by a renewed spike in energy prices.

title: Meituan’s 500% Estimate Surge May Revive China Delivery Stocks
summary: The latest batch of earnings showed the impact of China’s intense food-delivery price competition is fading more quickly than expected, removing a major drag on sector stocks.

title: Australia Tells ING to Boost Capital on Flawed Liquidity Reports
summary: Australia’s banking regulator put additional capital requirements on ING Bank Australia Ltd. after the lender revealed it had misreported its liquidity position over several years.

title: Malaysia Johor Regent TMJ’s Plan to Sell Singapore Land Clouded by Huge Tax Bill
summary: A Malaysian royal’s plan to sell a tract of land in the heart of Singapore faces a complication: a tax bill that may exceed $1 billion.

title: Five Below Lifts Outlook, Aims to Ramp Up Appeal to Gen Alpha
summary: Five Below Inc. shares rose over 8% in postmarket trading on Wednesday after the retailer lifted its full-year outlook, citing the addition of new stores and the popularity of its budget-friendly merchandise among Gen Alpha and Gen Z shoppers.

title: Petco Services, Auto-Ship Sales Grow as Turnaround Continues
summary: Petco Health & Wellness Co. shares rose as much as 14% in postmarket trading Wednesday after the pet supply retailer reported profit above Wall Street expectations and comparable sales grew for the second straight quarter after a year of declines.

title: Stocks Rise as Buyers Scoop Up Bargains After Rout: Markets Wrap
summary: Stocks rose after a drop fueled by concerns about inflation, with attractive valuations and solid corporate earnings luring bargain hunters.

title: NBA Suspends Clippers Owner Ballmer After Leonard Salary Probe
summary: The NBA stripped the Los Angeles Clippers of five first-round draft picks and suspended owner Steve Ballmer for one year after finding the team had circumvented salary cap rules by facilitating sponsorship agreements between outside companies and star player Kawhi Leonard. Randall Williams reports on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Shaquille O’Neal Kicks off College Tour on Credit
summary: Shaquille O'Neal, 15-time NBA All-Star, joins Romaine Bostick on 'The Close' to discuss his 'Credit Tip Off Tour' with Credit One Bank to educate students about building credit. He also gets into his latest venture as a DJ. (Source: Bloomberg)
